_note: A school of six small silvery reef fish, each about 190 mm long: a body flattened side to side and widest a third back from the snout, ten-sided, blue-grey on the back with a yellow stripe along the flank and a pale belly; an eye on each side of the head, a swept dorsal fin, pectoral fins behind the gills, pelvic and anal fins below and a forked yellow tail. They swim nose first round a loop 3.2 m across about 0.9 m over the sand, once every 24 s, tails beating (sway). The middle of the model is the loop's middle. Written by tools/models/scenery.py.
